provides: Expo SDK 58 app (React Native 0.88, React 19) with App.tsx rendering src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: a title and an accessible primary button
src/theme/tokens.ts design tokens consumed through StyleSheet.create
src/domain with one pure function and its vitest test (npm test runs vitest run; keep tests free of react-native imports)
npm run check runs typecheck (tsc --noEmit, strict), lint (Biome) and the tests
npm run build:web exports the web build with React Native Web to dist/ for the browser review
ui-routes.json at the root with the default ["/"]: a JSON array of absolute route paths captured by the browser (keep this exact format)
src/storage/secureToken.ts: pure createTokenStore(backend) over a SecureBackend interface; src/storage/expoSecureBackend.ts wires expo-secure-store 58.0.2 (tokens never go to AsyncStorage)
src/navigation/validateDeepLink.ts: pure allowlist validator (schemes, hosts, paths; rejects javascript:, traversal) with tests; policy in deepLinkPolicy.ts, scheme in app.json
src/theme/tokens.ts light and dark palettes with selectColors(scheme), useColors() hook (useColorScheme), contrast test >= 4.5:1 in both themes; userInterfaceStyle automatic
src/security/sourceRules.test.ts failing when AsyncStorage is imported in a file with token-like keys or an EXPO_PUBLIC_ variable looks like a secret
src/net/secureFetch.ts: createSecureFetch(fetch, policy) returns a result; https only, host allowlist, rejects insecure redirects; all fetch calls must use it (source rule)
src/i18n/{messages,t}.ts: typed message table with t('key'), no i18n library
docs/SECURITY-MOBILE.md (transport, secrets, optional biometric lock, screenshots, clipboard, permissions, privacy manifest) and docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md
sourceRules.test.ts also fails on http urls, fetch outside secureFetch, clipboard with tokens, Pressable without role and label, and an app.json with arbitrary loads, cleartext or Android permissions
